title: NAVIS AI
description: An AI-powered assistive navigation system helping visually impaired individuals move independently — winner of 1st place in Abu Dhabi University's Undergraduate Research & Innovation Competition.

caseStudy.problem: Visually impaired individuals often lack affordable, independent tools for real-time navigation and obstacle awareness in everyday environments.
caseStudy.solution: Designed an AI-powered assistive system that helps users navigate independently, combining real-time sensing with accessible audio feedback.
caseStudy.impact: Won 1st place among competing undergraduate research teams for technical innovation and real-world impact; now an ongoing research project.

title: ClearSpeech
description: An AI-powered speech therapy platform that helps users with speech impairments practice pronunciation, built and owned end-to-end as a freelance project for Key2Enable.

caseStudy.problem: People with speech impairments often lack accessible, engaging tools to practice pronunciation outside of costly, infrequent therapy sessions.
caseStudy.solution: Developed and integrated machine learning models for speech analysis and real-time feedback, then owned the entire product lifecycle solo — from requirements through deployment.
caseStudy.impact: Delivered a working AI speech-therapy platform for Key2Enable, giving users a way to practice pronunciation with real-time, automated feedback.

title: UAE Connect
description: An end-to-end microservices-based system built for a Distributed Systems course, covering service discovery, inter-service communication, and API management.

caseStudy.problem: Needed to design a production-style distributed system demonstrating service discovery, async messaging, and centralized API management at a course-project scale.
caseStudy.solution: Designed and implemented an end-to-end microservices system, integrating Apache Kafka for asynchronous messaging and Kong API Gateway for centralized routing and authentication.
caseStudy.impact: Containerized services with Docker and orchestrated deployment via Kubernetes, producing a scalable, production-style setup and hands-on distributed-systems experience later applied at Alef Education.
